title: Data resilience: last-good backup, push-triggered sync, instant promotions
description:
Epic tracking the three workstreams from the 2026-09-05 outage (empty PVC + Obsidian REST down → site served 0 games for weeks) and Yuri's follow-up asks.

Full plan (context, steps, verification, out-of-scope):
.agents/plans/2026-09-05_16-34-obsidian-down-last-good-cache.md

Workstreams:
A — GCS last-good backup of catalog.json + users.json; restore-first in the worker cycle.
B — Sync on every push to the Obsidian vault repo; remove the board-games 5-min cron (requires fixing the failing obsidian-vault-sync upstream).
C — Cover promotions in bg-admin reflect on live immediately (cache-busted display URLs).
